sources.summary: ViTrox Corporation Bhd (KL: VITROX) reported strong 3QFY2026 results, driven by record volume. Key figures: - 3QFY2026 net profit: RM118.6 million (up from RM34.7 million YoY) - 3QFY2026 revenue: RM485.1 million (up ~110% YoY) - 9MFY2026 net profit: RM254.8 million (up from RM87 million YoY) - 9MFY2026 revenue: RM1.13 billion (up from RM552.7 million) Outlook: - Expects a favorable business environment through FY2026 and into 2027. - Growth drivers: robust semiconductor sector, continued data centre capex, rising demand for edge AI devices. - Aims to capture opportunities in AI accelerators and high-bandwidth memory (HBM) complexity. Note: The summary reflects the latest quarterly (3QFY2026) and year-to-date performance reported by ViTrox; no separate annual report figures beyond nine-month results are provided in the excerpt. For the full latest Bursa Malaysia quarterly and annual reports, refer to ViTrox’s official disclosures and Bursa filing.
sources.snippet: KUALA LUMPUR (Nov 5): ViTrox Corporation Bhd (KL: VITROX) is upbeat after the semiconductor equipment maker posted its best quarter since listing in 2005, as higher volume drove down unit costs. Net profit for the three months ended Sept 30, 2026 (3QFY2026) was RM118.6 million, more than tripled from RM34.7 million a year earlier, according to an exchange filing. Revenue was up more than 110% year-on-year to RM485.1 million. Looking ahead, ViTrox expects a favourable business environment for the remainder of the financial year and into 2027, supported by robust growth in the semiconductor sector, continued investment in data centre infrastructure and rising demand for edge artificial intelligence (AI) devices. The company — which makes machines used to automatically inspect and detect defects in semiconductor components and printed circuit board assemblies — said it is seeking to capture a slice of the increasing complexity of AI accelerators and high bandwidth memory.

sources.snippet: # ViTrox’s 3Q26 profit more than triples Friday, 06 Nov 2026 Revenue for the third quarter was also higher at RM485.10mil, compared with RM228.57mil a year earlier. PETALING JAYA: Vitrox Corp Bhd’s profit has more than tripled in the third quarter ended Sept 30, 2026 (3Q26), coming in at RM118.58mil compared to RM34.72mil registered in the same quarter last year. Revenue for the quarter under review was also higher at RM485.10mil, compared with RM228.57mil a year earlier. In a statement to Bursa Malaysia, the industrial Internet-of-Things solutions provider said the increases were on the back of strong demand across its Automated Board Inspection and Machine Vision System segments. Both segments were supported by expanded adoption of advanced inspection solutions for artificial intelligence infrastructure and networking equipment. The group noted that tax incentives from its key subsidiary, ViTrox Technologies Sdn Bhd, contributed to its bottom line. “We will continue to exercise prudent cost management and operational discipline,” it added.
